Regional bank rolls out GenAI advisor for retail customers

A regional bank has launched a generative AI assistant that helps relationship managers answer questions about retail products & services.

Built on unified customer data

The bank said the assistant relies on a unified customer data platform that merges transactions, app behaviour and branch interactions.

  • Pilot runs in 20 branches across the region.
  • Staff remain responsible for every recommendation.
Our goal is to give every adviser the context of the whole relationship, not just one product.
